subject: Request: Post-report supplemental assurance statement for procurement
messages:
From: Helen Park <h.park@amplitudehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@amplitudehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up: request for post-report supplemental assurance statement

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this call earlier. Procurement is asking us for a short, company-signed supplemental assurance statement that covers the period after your report end date (SOC 2 Type II ended 2024-06-30) up to the present. They don't need a full new audit — just a letter we can include in the vendor packet that: 1) confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment, and 2) outlines any interim mitigations for changes that did occur.

If possible we need:
- A one-page signed statement on Redwood letterhead
- The exact statement period called out (2024-07-01 through 2027-06-30)
- A brief annex listing evidence available for procurement (SOC 2 report, KMS attestation, incident log summary)

Timeline: procurement needs this in their system by Friday 2027-07-02 to keep our deal on schedule.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a company-signed supplemental assurance (not auditor-signed) and who would sign? Also, procurement will ask for a high-level KMS/crypto summary. Attaching our procurement checklist in a separate email.

Thanks,
Helen
---
Helen Park
Sourcing Lead, Amplitude Health
h.park@amplitudehealth.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <h.park@amplitudehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: request for post-report supplemental assurance statement

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a company-signed supplemental assurance statement (signed by VP of Security or Head of Compliance) and we can include a short annex of evidence.

Quick clarifying Qs to make sure we deliver exactly what procurement needs:
- Confirm the requested period: you listed through 2027-06-30; do you want the letter to state "through June 30, 2027" or "through today"? Procurement often prefers explicit dates.
- Do they require the statement to reference specific controls or just a high-level affirmation?
- Is there any legal language procurement insists on (e.g., limitation of liability phrasing) or is a plain affirmation sufficient?

Next steps from our side: I will draft a one-page company letter + 1-page annex summarizing evidence (SOC 2 pdf, KMS note, recent incident log extract). I can circulate a redline for your review this afternoon and provide a DocuSign link for signature. Attaching our current SOC 2 Type II for reference.

If procurement needs an auditor-signed bridge, we can discuss but that's usually not required for commercial procurement.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Helen Park <h.park@amplitudehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@amplitudehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: request for post-report supplemental assurance statement

Naomi — thanks, that sounds good. Procurement confirms:
- Use explicit dates: 2024-07-01 through 2027-06-30.
- A high-level affirmation is fine; they want one sentence per bullet if there were changes and a short mitigation note.
- No extra legal language required, but procurement will upload the PDF to our Vendor Security Portal; they need the document to explicitly list the associated SOC 2 report filename you provide.

Procurement contact for sign-off is: procure@amplitudehealth.com — please include them on the final delivery.

I've pasted the procurement checklist highlight here for your convenience:
- SOC 2 report (pdf)
- Company-signed interim/explanatory letter (pdf)
- KMS/crypto description (1 page)
- Latest uptime/incident summary (1 page)

Appreciate the fast turnaround. If you can get the draft to me by 3pm ET, I'll route it for internal approval immediately.

Best,
Helen
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <h.park@amplitudehealth.com>, procure@amplitudehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20240630.pdf (SOC 2 report)

This statement is provided for vendor risk management purposes and is not an attestation by an independent auditor."

I recommend the letter be signed by our Head of Compliance, Karthik Iyer. Karthik — can you review the draft and confirm if you're comfortable signing?

1) Karthik reviews and confirms signature (I can also prepare the DocuSign envelope).
2) We export the signed PDF and send it to procure@amplitudehealth.com and Helen.
3) We update HubSpot (AMP-4720) with the documents and the intake notes.
